# Mosen — Muhammad Mohsin | Product Engineer, Designer & Automation Builder

## Who is Mosen?

Muhammad Mohsin, operating under the identity "Mosen", is a one-person product engineering studio based in Pakistan.  
He is a Product Engineer, Visual Designer, and Workflow Automation Builder.  
He works on the intersection of structured UI architecture, commercial automation infrastructure, and digital revenue systems.

## Core Competencies

- **Product Engineering**: Full-stack web applications, SaaS systems, Next.js/React, TypeScript, Node.js
- **Visual Design**: UI/UX system design, responsive layout engineering, component architecture
- **Workflow Automation**: Business process automation, lead generation pipelines, CRM integrations
- **AI-enhanced systems**: AI-assisted workflows, LLM integrations into product pipelines

## Philosophy

"One person. Three disciplines. Zero handoffs."  
Muhammad Mohsin combines engineering, design, and automation into a single delivery loop — removing the gap between idea, interface, and execution engine.

## Services

1. **Automation Systems** — Internal business automation tools, workflow engines, ERP components
2. **Revenue Engines** — Lead generation systems, funnels, performance dashboards
3. **Frontend Engineering** — Modern web applications, native-feeling UI systems
